chk_staff_hierarchy.name: chk_staff_hierarchy
chk_staff_hierarchy.value:
("staff_users"."role" = 'master' AND "staff_users"."parent_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("staff_users"."role" IN ('manager', 'runner') AND "staff_users"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_customers_ownership.name: chk_customers_ownership
chk_customers_ownership.value:
("customers"."runner_id" IS NULL AND "customers"."owner_staff_id" = "customers"."manager_id")
          OR ("customers"."runner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."owner_staff_id" = "customers"."runner_id" AND "customers"."manager_id" IS NOT NULL)
